name: recommendation-writer
description: Writes the decision-ready close of a design project, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run recommendation-writer", "write the recommendation", "what do we tell them to do", "close out the project", or the work is done and one page has to carry the decision to someone who was never in a session. Use it even for "the sponsor wants to know what's next".
